verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a national IP office could publish bulk registry extracts or datasets. The evidence only covers filing procedures and mentions that applications are published in the Boletim da Propriedade Industrial. Nothing documents bulk downloads, machine-readable registry extracts or open datasets that would avoid scraping.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
